name: 属性名・演算子・値・削除・追加を持つ条件チップ
prompt:
Create a single compact Linear filter-condition chip as a standalone image. The primary original crop is 249x33 (7.55:1); match this very wide, shallow geometry with the chip and its plus control filling the canvas. Do not use a square or 3:1 canvas with large blank margins. The source screenshot controls exact segment boundaries, icon silhouettes, border, spacing and colors; use the Japanese mock only for translated text.

From left to right, show one joined segmented condition chip: a small priority-bars icon followed by 「優先度」; a narrow operator segment with 「が」; a value segment with the matching priority-bars icon and 「高」; then a small x remove control at the rounded right end. Place a separate small gray plus sign just to the right with the same spacing as the source. Preserve the very light neutral outlines and vertical separators between the three segments, white fill, compact 33px-equivalent height, restrained gray icons/text and rounded outside corners.

Do not add labels, extra conditions, counts, background rows, page chrome or blank whitespace. Keep all content on one horizontal line and preserve the source crop's proportions.
reviewNotes: v001 contains the correct Japanese segmented condition and icons, but the 1956x804 image aspect 2.433:1 is far from the 249x33 source crop (7.545:1), leaving large blank margins.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
